Agent Name: DataAnalysis_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The agent assumed the Discography on the main Mercedes Sosa page was in a table and tried scraping tables with a “Discography” header. On Wikipedia, the artist’s main page typically links to a separate “Main article: [Artist] discography,” and does not present the studio albums in a table there. This incorrect extraction strategy (not following the discography link and not parsing the correct section format) yielded no data and set the process on the wrong path, directly leading to the failure to determine the count.
